description:
This project is a library for implementing OpenCNPJ API in Java.
        It provides a simple and efficient way to access the OpenCNPJ API, which allows users to retrieve information about Brazilian companies using their CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica) number.
        The library is designed to be easy to use and integrate into Java applications, making it a convenient tool for developers who need to work with company data in Brazil.
